name: Chief Hawkwind
summary: At Camp Narache, Chief Hawkwind readies young Shu'halo for life beyond Red Cloud Mesa. He guides their traditional rites in Mulgore and teaches humility, respect for the land, and the strength to protect their people.

sections.title: Chieftain of the Mesa
sections.body: At Camp Narache, Chief Hawkwind prepares young tauren for life beyond Red Cloud Mesa. Fledgling hunters, shamans, druids, and warriors undertake the ancient Rites of the Earthmother on the mesa. Hawkwind oversees their customs and teaches each youth duty and endurance before they leave its safety.

sections.title: Guiding the Rites
sections.body: Chief Hawkwind begins with humility, not martial glory. He sends initiates to fetch clean spring water and perform simple chores, teaching reverence for nature and their elders. Once they show humility, the braves face tests of martial skill. Their trials test their resolve against aggressive Bristleback quilboar encroaching on the ancestral plains.

sections.title: Defending Camp Narache
sections.body: Danger presses close to Camp Narache. The Bristleback tribe grows bolder along Red Cloud Mesa's perimeter. Hawkwind coordinates the settlement's defense and sends newly proven braves to blunt quilboar assaults and keep the sacred training grounds secure.

aliases: who is the chief at camp narache
faq.answer: Chief Hawkwind leads Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa. He oversees tribal matters and mentors young tauren preparing to enter the wider world of Mulgore and Kalimdor.

faq.q: What are the Rites of the Earthmother?
faq.answer: The Rites of the Earthmother are sacred trials young tauren undertake as they come of age. Elders such as Chief Hawkwind guide the rites, which test humility, strength, courage, and spiritual ties to the land and ancestors.

faq.q: Why does Chief Hawkwind have you fetch water first?
faq.answer: Chief Hawkwind has you fetch water to teach that service and respect for the community matter as much as martial strength. Gathering fresh water for tribal elders teaches patience and humility before initiates face battle.

faq.q: What threat is Camp Narache facing?
faq.answer: Hostile Bristleback quilboar from the hills around Red Cloud Mesa keep pressure on Camp Narache. Chief Hawkwind organizes the mesa's defense and sends initiates to thin their ranks.

faq.q: Where does Chief Hawkwind send adventurers next?
aliases: where do i go after hawkwind
faq.answer: After a young brave completes the preliminary rites on the mesa, Chief Hawkwind sends them into Mulgore's valleys. They travel to Bloodhoof Village to find Chief Baine Bloodhoof, son of Cairne, and continue the Rites of the Earthmother.

faq.q: Is Chief Hawkwind related to Greatmother Hawkwind?
faq.answer: Yes. Greatmother Hawkwind is Chief Hawkwind's mother. Their family has deep roots and a long history of leadership among the tauren of Red Cloud Mesa.

angles.text: As a tauren, you learn the Shu'halo's first values from Chief Hawkwind: reverence for the Earthmother, loyalty to your tribe, and humility in strength.
As a member of the Horde, you join newly raised tauren braves shaped by Hawkwind's teachings into capable warriors and spellcasters, and steadfast, honorable allies.
